jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Overview Most data engineering jobs are maintenance. This one is construction. You would be standing up ETL on Databricks and Spark for a National Guard analytics platform that is still being built, designing the models, setting the governance, and deciding how it works rather than inheriting a decade of someone else's decisions. FWI is hiring a Data Engineer to support enterprise data analytics and AI/ML modernization for the National Guard Bureau, part of a larger Office of the Under Secretary of War for Personnel and Readiness (OUSW(P&R)) data analytics program. You will design, build, and maintain the data infrastructure behind a National Guard community data and analytics environment, the pipelines, models, and governance that make enterprise personnel and readiness data usable. This is hands-on pipeline engineering at enterprise scale, on a platform where data quality has direct operational consequences. FWI is expanding rapidly and has been recognized as a 2024, 2025, and 2026 Top Workplace, offering excellent growth opportunities in a collaborative environment. Work Schedule and Location: Hybrid : This role is based in Arlington, Virginia and works on a hybrid schedule, typically 1–2 days on site per week, with the balance remote. We are looking for someone in the National Capital Region who can be on site when the mission calls for it, not only on a fixed schedule. Working alongside the government team in person is part of how this role builds the relationships the work depends on. FWI is expanding rapidly and has been recognized as a 2024, 2025 and 2026 Top Workplace, offering excellent growth opportunities in a collaborative environment . Responsibilities Design, develop, and implement end-to-end data pipelines using ETL processes and technologies including Databricks, Python, Spark, Scala, JavaScript/JSON, and SQL Build and optimize pipelines from scratch, with scalability, reliability, and high-performance processing as first-order requirements Work with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and design the data models and architectures to meet them Perform data cleansing, integration, and quality assurance to maintain the accuracy and integrity of large datasets Apply big data technologies to process and analyze large datasets efficiently Partner with data scientists, analysts, and government stakeholders to deliver timely, accurate data that supports decision-making Troubleshoot complex data problems and develop practical solutions Implement and enforce data governance policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practice Required Qualifications Active DoD Secret clearance (final, in current scope) Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related field 3+ years of directly related experience as a Data Engineer Proficiency in ETL processes, with firsthand experience across technologies such as Databricks, Python, Spark, Scala, JavaScript/JSON, SQL, and Jupyter Notebooks Demonstrated experience working with large datasets and using big data technologies to process and analyze data efficiently Working understanding of data modeling and visualization, database design principles, and data governance practice Based in the National Capital Region, or willing to relocate, and able to report to the Arlington site as needed U.S. citizenship (required for the clearance) Desired Experience supporting the Department of War mission and familiarity with its associated datasets Prior work in Advana or the War Data Platform API development and integration experience Experience with machine learning models and/or generative AI Experience building in Palantir Foundry, including Workshop, Ontology Manager, and Gaia FWI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/vets. Why Join Our Team Benefits At FWI, we place the highest importance on creating an exceptional employee experience. You'll have opportunities to achieve your career aspirations through internal promotions, professional development, and other recognition and rewards programs. Join our team and take advantage of the many benefits we offer, including: Health Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Long-term and Short-term Disability Insurance Life Insurance 401(k) Plan Holiday Pay Paid Time Off Pay Range $115,000 – $125,000 annually , depending on experience, education, and clearance level.

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Amazon Security Experience
jobs.description: Description The Amazon Security Experiences (ASE) organization is the data intelligence backbone of Amazon Security. We build and operate the data platform that powers security insights, builder experience analytics, and tooling decisions across Amazon's security ecosystem. Every insight surfaced to security leadership, from builder productivity trends to security issue quality metrics, flows through systems our team designs, builds, and maintains. We operate at scale, processing large volumes of security and operational data daily through hundreds of pipelines consisting of transformations, reporting queries, ingestions, and infrastructure management scripts. Our engineers work directly with source systems across AWS and SDO (Security, Developer, and Operations) data domains to procure data, convert it into structured formats, build large-scale processing pipelines, design analytical data models, and maintain infrastructure with the highest security and compliance standards. We are seeking a Data Engineer I to join our Security Data Intelligence (SDI) team. In this role, you will build and maintain data pipelines that power security analytics across Amazon. Working with well-defined requirements and guidance from senior engineers, you will create physical data models, optimize data pipelines for defined datasets, and deliver reliable, well-documented solutions on schedule. You will partner with teams across ASE, BizOps, MapSec, and other security organizations to implement data ingestion flows and support analytical models that serve the broader Amazon Security organization. Key job responsibilities Learn and apply team-established data processing guidelines and best practices when building and testing pipelines. Measure and improve dataset quality across owned pipelines, identifying issues and proposing solutions to the team. Flag limitations or opportunities in data processing tools to senior engineers for evaluation. Learn and understand the team's existing data architecture, including how security data flows through ingestion, transformation, and serving layers. Build data solutions at the component level within the established team data architecture, following defined logical data models. Create physical data models for assigned datasets, applying appropriate persistence and integration techniques. Understand the implications of implementation decisions (e.g., normalization, distribution) and seek guidance from senior engineers on trade-offs. Write secure, stable, testable, and maintainable code with minimal defects, following team coding standards. Clearly document solutions for ease of use and maintainability by teammates and data consumers. Get all data models, pipeline designs, and code reviewed by senior engineers before deployment. Test code thoroughly and understand the maintenance characteristics, runtime properties, and dependencies of delivered solutions. Build and maintain data pipeline infrastructure for assigned datasets using team-established patterns and tools. Apply basic database optimization techniques such as partitioning, distribution, and indexing as directed. Understand the underlying system infrastructure that data solutions depend on, including differences between data persistence solutions. Follow team guidelines for infrastructure management, security compliance, and automation practices. Solve straightforward, well-defined problems with guidance from senior engineers, for example, building ingestion pipelines for a new security data source where the schema and requirements are defined, or troubleshooting data quality issues in existing datasets by researching root causes and thoroughly resolving defects. Handle problems even outside your own domain by either resolving them or ensuring a clear hand-off to the right owner. Take well-defined requirements and deliver solutions on schedule within assigned scope. Participate in team design, scoping, and prioritization discussions to understand project context. Manage your own task execution effectively, seeking guidance when blocked or uncertain. Communicate progress and dependencies clearly to your team lead and senior engineers. Build good working relationships with teammates, peer engineers, and data consumers across ASE and SDO. Partner effectively with Business Analysts, Data Scientists, and peer SDEs to understand data requirements. Help train and mentor DE interns when applicable. Participate in the interview process. Recognize discordant views and participate in constructive dialogue with peers. Follow team-established best practices for data discovery, naming conventions, and data security. Classify, store, and handle data per Amazon security and compliance policies. Ensure proper access control, data integrity, and auditability for all produced datasets. Track security risks in data handling, mitigate issues, and escalate in a timely manner. Identify data quality issues and pipeline deficiencies in owned components and propose solutions to the team. Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team planning sessions. Make small improvements to team development processes when directed. Actively seek knowledge of team data architecture and apply learnings to improve your data solutions. Participate in on-call rotation and respond to pipeline incidents following established runbooks and escalation procedures. Understand the maintenance characteristics, runtime properties, and dependencies of team data systems. Contribute to monitoring and alarming setup for owned pipelines with guidance from senior engineers. Document incident resolutions and contribute to runbook updates for owned components. Basic Qualifications 2+ years of data engineering experience Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines Experience with one or more query language (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala) Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell) Preferred Qualifications Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR Experience with any ETL tool like, Informatica, ODI, SSIS, BODI, Datastage, etc. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits. USA, WA, Seattle - 101,300.00 - 160,000.00 USD annually Company - Amazon.com Services LLC Job ID: A10582746

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Cumberland/Options
jobs.description: DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk. Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets. We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus. About The Team The DRW Cumberland & Options Data Engineering team is essential to developing valuable datasets and scalable data infrastructure critical to our trading operations. We work closely with traders, researchers, and other engineering teams to ensure seamless data flow and accessibility, supporting data-driven decision-making. Our systems are designed to handle large volumes of data, maintain quality and integrity, and provide robust APIs for fast, ergonomic data retrieval. About The Role We are seeking a Data Engineer to join our trading team. This role will be responsible for onboarding, transforming, and curating datasets. You will collaborate closely with traders, researchers, and quantitative developers to support options and delta-one trading strategies. In this role you will: Build, maintain, and manage core trading datasets Implement data quality and control processes Incorporate new data from both internally derived and vendor systems Collaborate with research teams to apply novel ideas to historic data sets Create AI sympathetic annotations to new and existing data sets Qualifications 3+ years of demonstrated experience designing and implementing ingestion pipelines Foundational understanding of the Python data science ecosystem Strong understanding of option and future products and their respective data requirements Strong understanding of financial point-in-time and time-series data and analysis An understanding of the financial data vendor landscape and product offerings Proven expertise in developing data quality control processes to detect gaps or inaccuracies Experience with monitoring, observability, and alerting systems for data pipelines Proven ability to work in an agile, fast-paced environment and handle trading environment demands The annual base salary range for this position is $150,000 to $200,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts. For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice. California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice. LI-BL1

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. We are responsible for developing the Chat AI assistant, Voice AI Assistant and more! jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Agility Partners is seeking a qualified Engineer to fill an open position with one of our clients in the energy industry. This is an exciting opportunity to build and enhance cloud-based data platforms, backend services, and AI-enabled applications that support data-driven business solutions. The ideal candidate will combine data engineering and software development expertise to create reliable data pipelines, scalable APIs, and integrated analytics capabilities using modern Azure technologies. A Little About This Gig Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and orchestration workflows using Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, SQL, and Python. Build and support backend services, REST APIs, and application integrations using Python, FastAPI, Azure Functions, and containerized solutions. Implement data quality checks, validation frameworks, automated testing, and CI/CD processes to improve reliability and streamline deployment. Integrate machine learning and AI capabilities into data platforms and applications, including feature pipelines, model-serving APIs, and agentic architectures. The Ideal Candidate Hands-on experience with data engineering tools and technologies, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, SQL, and Python. Experience developing and maintaining data pipelines, orchestration workflows, and data integration solutions. Proficiency in Python-based software development, including building backend services and REST APIs with frameworks such as FastAPI. Familiarity with Azure Functions, containerized services, and cloud-based application architecture. Experience with GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and software deployment best practices. Understanding of asynchronous or event-driven architectures and integrating applications with data platforms.
